purpose: Artwork upload pipeline root-cause and verified canary checkpoint

rootCause.finding: TheTVDB artwork upload is a two-stage flow. POST /artwork/upload_handler only creates a temporary incoming image and returns an Adjust Image page. A second POST to /artwork/upload_cropper_handler via the Finish button is required to create the persistent episode artwork.
rootCause.priorImpact: Earlier Elian and Mcfly artwork canaries stopped after stage 1, explaining HTTP 200 responses with no materialized artwork.
rootCause.officialRequirements: Episode image upload requires at least 640x360 for HD 16:9 and <=10MB; canary used 1280x720 JPEG.

safeguards: Fresh episode/title/artwork preflight before each write
Only exact official YouTube-matched artwork candidates
Verify persistent episode artwork after Finish
Do not upload historical/no-current-video artwork speculatively
Do not overwrite episodes that already have artwork
Use guarded batches rather than unverified bulk submission
